result.summary: PASS, pass 3 of 3. The three fixes of step 04e (L5, L6 = F6, F5) do what they say, nothing else changed since my pass 2, and there is no regression. No Critical, High or Medium finding. The three items that step 04e found outside its list (its I2, I3 and I4) are Low and go to defects at step 10 (L7, L8, issue I1). (b) Only these fixes changed. Against my pass-2 copy (the code of step 04b) the diff of stand.js is: the constant MAX_TIMER_MS with its line comment (25); the comment above baseEnvironment() (27-32); the cwd message (96); the range check of the two timeouts (112-116); the guarded end in the branch of a child that ended before its link (396-402). The README diff is line 844 only. index.js and fake-stand.js are byte for byte as before, and nothing else under tools/ is changed. (a) Each fix proved on a fresh clone of the tag with the current files (pass3.mjs, 23 of 23 green). The same trial on the code of step 04b is 22 of 23 red, so it sees the old defects. L5: 0, -1, 1.5, NaN, Infinity, 2^31 and a string, for each of the two timeouts, give USAGE '<option> must be a whole number of milliseconds from 1 to 2147483647' with 0 spawns and nothing made. On the old code 2^31 passed the check and reached the spawn. 2147483647 for both is accepted and kept: the link printed after 800 ms is still read, stop() gives {code: 0}, and there is no TimeoutOverflowWarning. My old bigtimeout.mjs, which asserted the overflow, now sees the USAGE refusal at once (0 ms), as the task says. The cwd message is 'cwd must be a non-empty path without NUL' for empty, NUL and a number. F5: a deps.spawn child that sends close with no exit gives STAND_START_EXITED 'fake exited before it printed its link (exit code null). Last line of its stderr: "fake child: going away"', with exitCode and signal null. Nothing is registered and there is no marker, with no pid and with pid 999999; on the old code it was a TypeError with the marker (and the group) left. L6: measured again (envtruth.mjs): the child gets __CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING beyond the given names, and NODE_V8_COVERAGE too when the spec process has it, which is exactly what the new comment and the new README clause say. (c) No regression. group1 7/0, outcomes 18/0, withstand2 10/0, envtruth 4/0, precedence 25/0 (CLEANUP_FAILED in all four paths, the messages ending with the end of the main process, 3.0-4.0 s), drain 6/0, withchild 5/0, refusals 31/0, and EMFILE under ulimit gives STAND_START_FAILED with exit 0. o14 is 30/31: every O14 check is green, and the one red is case 8, which still asserts the self-reference that step 04b removed (expected since pass 2). The kit test file gives 52 tests, 51 pass, 1 fail = E2K-50 ('reads TEMP', red by the design until sub-step 3), with E2K-41 and E2K-60 green. Check (a) of section 14 prints 200 Учёт-Про {"code":0,"signal":null} "" (exit 0). The README keeps every earlier word: 153 of 153 of the pass-2 paragraph and 111 of 111 of the pass-1 paragraph, in order; only line 844 differs; prettier clean. Kit style: the line comment on a constant is the style of cleanup.js (lines 11-14); the messages have the shape of the existing ones ('… without NUL', the range said in words and numbers); the F5 guard is two lines with a comment that says when it is reached; eslint clean. There is no defensive noise. The only odd text is '(exit code null)' for an end that is unknown, and only a fake child can reach it; not a finding. Precedence and O14 are unchanged (#doStop not touched, and the zombie and O14 trials as above). Judged outside the change (step 04e issues): I2 = L7 below, Low. The unbounded wait in stop() is reachable only through deps.spawn: for a real child Node gives the exit event in the same callback in which it reaps the leader, so the group cannot be gone before the exit is seen, and every stop() of my real-process trials ended. In the tests the wait is bounded by the per-test timeout of node:test. I4 = L8 below, Low wording. I3 (the timeouts of browser.js, cdp.js, page.js, runner.js, cleanup.js are unchecked) is outside this change, Low (the callers are the kit's own code), issue I1. The task names no expected verdict (AP-018 not applicable).

findings.what: Once the group is gone, stop() waits for the exit event with no limit. A real child cannot hang it: Node gives the exit event in the same callback in which it reaps the leader, so the exit is seen before the group can be gone, and every stop() of my real-process trials ended. A fake child given through deps.spawn that never sends exit makes stop() wait until the test's own timeout (I2 of step 04e, measured there). This is a test seam only.
findings.fix: Defect at step 10: either race the two awaits with a limit (as the stop timer does) or state in the contract that a deps.spawn child must send exit and then close, as Node does, and let TEST-DESIGNER's fakes do so.
